section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. All data for this comparison were collected at the Oakfield Family Cohort.
